title: Figuring it Out: Augustana Commencement Speaker Encourages Class of 2026 to Embrace Uncertainty Post Graduation
summary_en: When Abel Alene ‘26 first arrived in South Dakota, he knew almost nothing about Sioux Falls or Augustana University. And Alene didn’t imagine he’d one day stand at the podium as his class’ commencement speaker.
title_cn: Figuring it Out: Augustana Commencement Speaker Encourages Class of 2026 to Embrace Uncertainty Post Graduation
